'''Damelien''' is a village in [[Andor]].

When [[Elayne Trakand]] and her group make their way to [[Caemlyn]] after [[Traveling]] from [[Altara]], they stay at an inn called [[The Golden Sheaves]]. While there, Elayne hears rumors that the [[Rand al'Thor|Dragon Reborn]] had killed both her and her [[Morgase Trakand|mother]].{{ref/book|8|20}}
